description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling the DeleteFeatureProperties command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages deletion of feature properties from a Thing entity, generating appropriate events and results.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertiesStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the deletion of feature properties in a Thing, producing events and results accordingly.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete feature properties command, returning a result with the corresponding event or error.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the specified feature from the Thing entity based on the command.

methods.name: getDeleteFeaturePropertiesResult
methods.description: Creates a result indicating successful deletion of feature properties or an error if not found.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous state of the feature, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional, indicating no specific next entity tag.
